title: 第二十一章 嫂子也有需求第二十二章 别委屈自己
content_zh:
三轮车突突突的声音在村口停下的时候，天边最后一抹晚霞正在消散，暮色像一层薄纱缓缓笼罩下来。
王大壮从车上跳下来，回头看了一眼车斗里空空荡荡的筐子，嘴角的笑意怎么都压不住。
他把钥匙还给周国强，又硬塞了一百块钱过去，说是油钱和感谢费，周国强推辞了两下也就收下了，拍着他的肩膀笑道：“大壮，以后要用车尽管来拿。”
“那就先谢谢国强叔了。”王大壮也是开心道。
从周国强家出来，村子里亮起了零星的灯光。
王大壮快步走在熟悉的土路上，口袋里那一万多块钱，内心激动恨不得立刻飞回那个小院，把钱往李玉梅面前一拍，看看她是什么表情。
推开院门的时候，院子里空荡荡的，灶房里没有灯光，堂屋的门也关着。
“嫂子？”王大壮喊了一声，没有人应答。
他愣了一下，走进堂屋，屋里收拾得干干净净，灶台上的锅碗也已经洗过了，锅盖盖得严严实实，灶膛里的火早就灭了，摸上去冰凉。
不在家？
王大壮转身出了堂屋，绕到屋后。
后院的菜地里青菜长得正旺，几只鸡在墙角叽叽喳喳地啄食，可李玉梅也不在这里。
他正要转身回去，目光不经意间扫过菜地尽头那片茂密的竹林，忽然看到一个熟悉的身影正弯腰钻进了竹林深处。
是李玉梅。
王大壮刚要开口喊，话到嘴边又咽了回去。
他注意到李玉梅手里提着两样东西——右手的锄头，左手的购物袋。
那个购物袋鼓鼓囊囊的，里面装着什么东西，从外面看不出来。
她走路的时候左顾右盼，像是在确认周围有没有人，动作鬼鬼祟祟的，跟平时那个大大方方的李玉梅判若两人。
王大壮的眉头微微皱了一下，心里涌起一股疑惑。
嫂子这是要干什么？

不由得，王大壮下意识地放轻了脚步，猫着腰跟在后面，借着夜色的掩护，悄悄摸到了竹林边缘。
竹林里的光线已经很暗了，但他还是能看清李玉梅的一举一动——她在一棵粗大的竹子旁边停下来，蹲下身，开始用锄头挖坑。
土质松软，她挖得很快，不一会儿就挖出了一个尺许深的坑。
然后李玉梅把那个购物袋放进坑里，用手把周围的泥土推回去，又用锄头把土拍实，最后还扯了几把枯草盖在上面，伪装得天衣无缝。
做完这一切，李玉梅站起身，拍了拍手上的泥土，拎着锄头走出了竹林。
她的表情看起来没什么异常，甚至还有些如释重负的轻松。
等李玉梅的身影彻底消失在竹林外，王大壮才从藏身的地方走出来，来到她刚才挖坑的位置。
他蹲下身，扒开那层枯草，用双手刨开松软的泥土，很快就摸到了那个购物袋。
他把购物袋从坑里提出来，拉开拉链，探头往里一看。
下一秒，王大壮的眼睛瞪得滚圆，嘴巴张成了o型，整个人像被雷劈了一样僵在原地。
购物袋里装着的，是一堆花花绿绿的情趣用品。
各种各样的，大大小小的，有些他认识，有些他连见都没见过。
那些东西被李玉梅用干净的塑料袋仔细地包裹着，保存得完好如新，显然是用心保管的。
王大壮盯着那些东西看了好一会儿，脸上的表情从震惊变成了复杂，又从复杂变成了一种说不清道不明的酸涩。
content_en:
When the churning sound of the tricycle stopped at the entrance of the village, the last ray of sunset on the horizon was dissipating, and the dusk slowly enveloped the place like a layer of gauze.
Wang Dazhuang jumped out of the car and looked back at the empty basket in the truck bed. He couldn't suppress the smile on his lips.
He returned the key to Zhou Guoqiang and forced another hundred yuan into it, saying it was for gas money and a thank you fee. Zhou Guoqiang accepted the offer after refusing twice, patted him on the shoulder and said with a smile: "Dazhuang, if you want to use the car in the future, just come and get it."
"Then thank you Uncle Guoqiang first." Wang Dazhuang also said happily.
After leaving Zhou Guoqiang's house, sporadic lights lit up in the village.
Wang Dazhuang walked quickly on the familiar dirt road. With more than 10,000 yuan in his pocket, he was so excited that he wanted to fly back to the small courtyard immediately, slap the money in front of Li Youmei's face, and see what her expression was.
When the courtyard door was opened, the courtyard was empty, there was no light in the kitchen, and the door to the main room was closed.
"Sister-in-law?" Wang Dazhuang called out, but no one answered.
He was stunned for a moment, then walked into the main room. The room was clean, the pots and bowls on the stove had been washed, and the pot lids were tightly covered. The fire in the stove had long been extinguished, and it was cold to the touch.
Not at home?
Wang Dazhuang turned around and walked out of the main room and walked around to the back of the room.
The vegetables are growing vigorously in the vegetable patch in the backyard, and a few chickens are chirping and pecking in the corner, but Li Youmei is not here either.
He was about to turn around and go back when his eyes inadvertently swept across the dense bamboo forest at the end of the vegetable field. Suddenly he saw a familiar figure bending down and getting into the depths of the bamboo forest.
It's Li Youmei.
Wang Dazhuang was about to shout, but he swallowed the words again.
He noticed that Li Youmei was holding two things in her hand - a hoe in her right hand and a shopping bag in her left hand.
The shopping bag was bulging and contained something that could not be seen from the outside.
She looked left and right as she walked, as if checking to see if anyone was around. Her movements were sneaky, completely different from the usual generous Li Youmei.
Wang Dazhuang frowned slightly, and doubts arose in his heart.
What is sister-in-law doing?
Involuntarily, Wang Dazhuang subconsciously slowed down his steps, hunched over and followed behind. Under the cover of the night, he quietly reached the edge of the bamboo forest.
The light in the bamboo forest was already very dark, but he could still see Li Youmei's every move clearly - she stopped next to a thick bamboo, squatted down, and started digging a hole with a hoe.
The soil was soft, so she dug quickly, and in a short time she dug a pit about a foot deep.
Then Li Youmei put the shopping bag into the pit, pushed back the surrounding soil with her hands, patted the soil firmly with a hoe, and finally pulled a few handfuls of withered grass to cover it, making the disguise perfect.
After doing all this, Li Youmei stood up, patted the soil on her hands, and walked out of the bamboo forest with her hoe.
Her expression didn't look unusual, even a little relieved.
After Li Youmei's figure completely disappeared outside the bamboo forest, Wang Dazhuang walked out of his hiding place and came to the location where she had just dug the hole.
He squatted down, peeled away the layer of dead grass, dug through the soft soil with his hands, and soon touched the shopping bag.
He lifted the shopping bag out of the pit, unzipped it, and looked inside.
The next second, Wang Dazhuang's eyes widened, his mouth opened into an O shape, and his whole body froze in place as if struck by lightning.
The shopping bag contains a bunch of colorful sex toys.
All kinds, big and small, some he knew, some he had never seen before.
Those things were carefully wrapped by Li Youmei in clean plastic bags and kept as good as new. They were obviously kept with care.
Wang Dazhuang stared at those things for a long time, and the expression on his face changed from shock to complexity, and then from complexity to an inexplicable sourness.
